fixed.member: Achievements, Chat, DailyQuests, DailyRewards, Friends, Shop, ShopConfirm
fixed.summary: General components use HTML-with-CSS roots, conditional optional content and bounded CSS scrollers. Names, descriptions and rewards have consistent spacing and readable hierarchy in the default style; reward calendars switch to four columns before narrow day states collide. Loading indicators remain visible, and existing ids, parts and keyed intents are preserved. The review sheet includes default-style desktop and phone pages.
